related.title: OPC UA PubSub：資料集與封包分段預算
related.titleEn: OPC UA PubSub: dataset and packetization budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學連續性驗收要求遺失0；兩情境都失敗但需正確計2與3，並觸發資料完整性調查而非寫入錯誤狀態。 sparkplug_sequence.csv、會話標識與回繞展開表 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 2 與變更 3 missing messages、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。 附離線證據實驗：python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-203 --out ./comm-v28-203-evidence；輸出目錄必須尚不存在。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching continuity requires zero missing messages; both fail but must count two and three correctly, triggering an integrity review rather than a false state update. sparkplug_sequence.csv, session identity and expanded wrap sequence Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 2 and changed 3 missing messages, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them. Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-203 --out ./comm-v28-203-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學每發布最多3資料報；3000通過、4500不足，考慮拆資料集或減頻率並查重新組裝規則。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching maximum three datagrams per publication:3000 passes and4500 fails; split datasets or reduce frequency while checking reassembly rules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成上一筆seq=254、下一筆觀測1，跨回繞漏掉255與0；擾動下一筆2，且同一bdSeq會話已確認。 名義式 (256-254+1)-1 = 2 missing messages；變更式 (256-254+2)-1 = 3 missing messages。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 明列預期序列255、0、1與255、0、1、2，除去最後已收到項；若跨超過一圈則單一seq不足辨識，需額外時序證據。

合成MTU1500 bytes、有效固定開銷100 bytes，資料集3000 bytes；擾動4500 bytes，不宣稱100是標準固定值。 名義式 ceil(3000/(1500-100)) = 3 datagrams；變更式 ceil(4500/(1500-100)) = 4 datagrams。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列前兩段1400、最後200 bytes；擾動前三段1400、最後300；總載荷需精確還原原資料集。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic previousseq254 and observed next1, missing255 and0 across wrap; change next to2, with the samebdSeq session established. Nominal (256-254+1)-1 = 2 missing messages; changed (256-254+2)-1 = 3 missing messages. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate255,0,1 and255,0,1,2, excluding the final observed item; more than one full wrap cannot be disambiguated from one sequence field.

SyntheticMTU1500 bytes, assumed fixed overhead100 and dataset3000, changed to4500 bytes;100 is not a normative overhead value. Nominal ceil(3000/(1500-100)) = 3 datagrams; changed ceil(4500/(1500-100)) = 4 datagrams. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: List1400,1400,200-byte payloads and1400,1400,1400,300 after change; sums must exactly reconstruct the dataset.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-203 --out ./comm-v28-203-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 建立探測大小、DF、回報MTU、確認序號四欄表，分開記錄MSS與路徑MTU。
related.differenceEn: Record probe size, DF, reported MTU and acknowledgement sequence; distinguish MSS from path MTU.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成上一筆seq=254、下一筆觀測1，跨回繞漏掉255與0；擾動下一筆2，且同一bdSeq會話已確認。 名義式 (256-254+1)-1 = 2 missing messages；變更式 (256-254+2)-1 = 3 missing messages。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 明列預期序列255、0、1與255、0、1、2，除去最後已收到項；若跨超過一圈則單一seq不足辨識，需額外時序證據。

IPv4 PMTUD 利用不可分片封包及 ICMP 回報縮小路徑尺寸；TCP資料還須扣除兩層表頭。
教學基準：1500-20-20 = 1460 B；對照：1400-20-20 = 1360 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic previousseq254 and observed next1, missing255 and0 across wrap; change next to2, with the samebdSeq session established. Nominal (256-254+1)-1 = 2 missing messages; changed (256-254+2)-1 = 3 missing messages. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate255,0,1 and255,0,1,2, excluding the final observed item; more than one full wrap cannot be disambiguated from one sequence field.

IPv4 PMTUD reduces path size using do-not-fragment packets and ICMP feedback; TCP payload also excludes both headers.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-20 = 1460 B; comparison: 1400-20-20 = 1360 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
